baseline_models.focus_anchor: خَلَقَ at word 2 followed by fa and سَوَّىٰ at word 3.
baseline_models.mechanism: The first root supplies both prior measurement and origination, while the second supplies straightening and completion. The fa moves from apportioned design through realized existence into sound form.

activation_trace.role: Measuring before cutting or acting supplies the designed specification of the creature.
Originating and bringing into being supplies realization of the measured design.
Straightness and intrinsic completeness supply the subsequent rectifying finish.

changed_reading.after: He measured a form, originated it, then rectified and completed it into soundness.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The paired focus verbs permit خَلَقَ to name both visible formation and inward disposition, with سَوَّىٰ completing either domain.
baseline_models.mechanism: Creation is not only an exterior outline. Visible form and inward character are co-formed, and the following leveling makes them coherent rather than merely geometrically symmetric.

activation_trace.role: Complete, balanced, visibly formed features supply the exterior dimension.
Inner disposition and character supply a second, non-visible dimension of created form.
Sound form or character makes leveling the coherence of both exterior and interior.

changed_reading.before: The creature was given a balanced physical shape.
changed_reading.after: The creature's visible form and inward disposition were brought into a coherent soundness.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: خَلَقَ can mark fitness for something, while a branch of سَوَّىٰ turns or intends toward a direction.
baseline_models.mechanism: The sequence can be functional rather than cosmetic: first an entity is made apt for an end, then its capacity is aimed toward a direction in which it can operate.

activation_trace.role: Worthiness and aptitude supply a created capacity fitted to an end.
Turning and intending toward a direction supplies orientation of that capacity.

changed_reading.before: Creation is followed by a finishing adjustment.
changed_reading.after: Creation confers aptitude, then directs that aptitude toward a fitting end.

context_deltas.mechanism: The preceding name-expression activates both naming as indication and, through the packet's non-dominant mapping, a visible identifying mark. Completed visible form can therefore be read as sign-bearing identity rather than anonymous shape.

activation_trace.role: Visible formed features provide the focus-side surface on which identity can appear.
Sound completion makes the identifying form stable and recognizable.
Naming as indication supplies the link from formed appearance to intelligible identity.
The split-root image of a visible mark makes identity materially legible in the completed form.

structural_cues: The name-expression in 87:1 immediately precedes the relative clause beginning with the focus ayah.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies naming, indication, and a visible mark; I infer that formed features can function as identifying signs. A live alternative is that اسم concerns only the commanded utterance and contributes nothing to the mechanics of creation.

changed_reading.before: He made a complete visible shape.
changed_reading.after: He formed and completed each thing so that its condition and identity could become visibly legible.

context_deltas.mechanism: The title رب activates repair, rearing, completion, nourishment, and growth. سَوَّىٰ is reopened from a single finishing stroke into the sustained maturation by which created form reaches soundness.

activation_trace.role: Origination supplies the beginning of the process that nurture subsequently carries forward.
Intrinsic soundness and completion supply the maturation endpoint.
Repairing, rearing, and completing turn the focus sequence into sustained formative care.
The non-dominant growth branch adds nourishment and development to the route toward completion.

structural_cues: The relative الذي links the creator in 87:2 back to ربك الأعلى in 87:1, while fa marks an act subsequent to creation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies lordship as repair, nurture, completion, and growth; I infer that these describe how the creator's leveling unfolds through time. The alternative is that رب identifies the agent without specifying the process denoted by سَوَّىٰ.

changed_reading.before: Creation is followed by an instantaneous completed adjustment.
changed_reading.after: Creation is followed by nurturing, repair, and growth until the creature reaches sound form.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next ayah's measure-then-guide sequence runs parallel to create-then-level. It sharpens خَلَقَ as specification and سَوَّىٰ as tuning a capacity toward a traversable path, so proportion is functional affordance.

activation_trace.role: Prior measuring in the focus root makes creation a specified rather than undifferentiated act.
Turning toward a direction lets leveling tune the measured form for a course.
A measure by which a thing reaches its limit confirms bounded capacity as the design input.
Gentle indication toward a path supplies the operational destination of the tuned capacity.

structural_cues: 87:2 and 87:3 are adjacent two-verb clauses with the same agent and a medial fa: خلق فسوى / قدر فهدى.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies measurement and gentle path-direction; I infer a parallel between خلق and قدر, and between سوى and هدى, so measured form enables guided action. The alternative is a list of four independent divine acts with no pairwise explanatory relation.

changed_reading.before: He proportioned the thing after making it.
changed_reading.after: He specified a bounded capacity, brought it into being, and tuned it so it could follow its fitting path.

context_deltas.mechanism: Pasture emerges from concealment, becomes usable sustenance, and is then transformed into dark, gathered spent matter. The focus's completion is thereby rescaled from a static perfect object to a balanced cycle of production, use, conversion, and return.

activation_trace.role: Origination anchors the cycle in the focus act of bringing a thing into being.
A middle, fair, or even state supplies system-level balance rather than permanent pristine shape.
Bringing something out of concealment supplies emergence into the productive phase.
Pasture and grazing supply the phase in which formed matter sustains other life.
Making a thing become another state supplies the explicit conversion arrow.
Pasture becoming dry debris supplies senescence and material turnover.
Gathering and containing supply reintegration of spent matter into a bounded system.

structural_cues: 87:4-5 retain the same divine agent and narrate emergence followed by explicit transformation of pasture into debris.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies emergence, pasture, transformation, debris, and gathering; I infer that سوى can describe balance across a whole turnover cycle. The alternative is that these are later examples of power and do not revise the focus verb beyond individual formation.

changed_reading.before: Leveling produces a finished object whose perfection is static.
changed_reading.after: Leveling establishes an ordered ecology whose soundness includes emergence, use, decay, and material return.

context_deltas.mechanism: Reading gathers distinctions, forgetting loses them, and knowledge recognizes a guiding mark across manifest and hidden states. These cues activate created, completed features as a legible order that can be gathered into cognition rather than only seen as shape.

activation_trace.role: Visible formed features provide differentiated signs capable of being read.
Sound completion organizes those signs into a coherent order.
Gathering and collecting supply the cognitive act of assembling differentiated features.
Loss of recollection supplies the failure mode against which legible order is retained.
A distinguishing mark that guides recognition connects knowledge to formed signs.
Appearance to the eye supplies the manifest register of the created order.
Removing hiddenness supplies disclosure of features not initially manifest.

structural_cues: 87:6-7 move from recitation and non-forgetting to comprehensive knowledge of what is manifest and hidden.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies gathering, forgetting, marks, manifestation, and disclosure; I supply the world-as-readable-order analogy linking those operations to formed features. The alternative is that the passage concerns revelation and divine knowledge only, without making creation itself legible.

changed_reading.before: He completed an object's visible form.
changed_reading.after: He formed distinctions into a coherent order whose manifest and hidden signs can be gathered, recognized, and recalled.

context_deltas.mechanism: Ease opens a path, remembrance reactivates what is held, benefit names successful uptake, and reverent fear describes receptivity. The focus's aptitude-and-orientation reading becomes an ergonomic preparation of the creature for responsive action.

activation_trace.role: Created aptitude supplies the capacity that can be made receptive.
Directing intention or movement toward a target supplies oriented use of that capacity.
Opening and ease after difficulty supply a low-resistance route for the capacity.
Bringing something back to mind supplies reactivation of a prepared capacity.
Benefit as the opposite of harm supplies the criterion of successful uptake.
Fear joined with awe supplies the receptive stance in which reminder becomes effective.

structural_cues: 87:8 promises facilitation, and 87:9-10 then describe whether reminder is beneficially received.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies ease, recollection, benefit, and receptive awe; I infer that formed aptitude is calibrated for response rather than merely possessed. The alternative is that facilitation is a special promise to the addressee, not a disclosure about created capacities generally.

changed_reading.before: He gave each creature a fitting form.
changed_reading.after: He fitted and oriented capacity so that a beneficial path could become easy to enter and responsive memory could awaken.

context_deltas.mechanism: Separation to a side, wretchedness, quiescent death, and life as benefit expose an uncomfortable possibility: an ordered or stabilized condition need not be flourishing. سَوَّىٰ can organize boundaries and states without making every resulting state harmonious.

activation_trace.role: A middle or even station supplies the equilibrium whose value is now questioned.
Distancing and separation supply boundary formation and exclusion to one side.
Wretchedness as the opposite of felicity blocks the assumption that every ordered state is good.
Quiescence and torpor supply a death-like pole without full release.
Life understood as benefit supplies the flourishing pole explicitly denied by the liminal construction.

structural_cues: 87:11 separates one recipient, and 87:13 holds him in the explicit double negation of neither dying nor living.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies separation, misery, death-like stillness, and beneficial life; I infer a stabilized but deprived interval and use it to weaken the equation of سوى with universal harmony. The alternative is that the punishment description has no semantic feedback on the focus act.

changed_reading.before: To level or complete necessarily means to produce a harmonious flourishing state.
changed_reading.after: Ordering can also establish boundaries or stable states whose equilibrium is deprived rather than flourishing.

context_deltas.mechanism: Measuring before cutting and preparing a smooth tract meet the plougher's splitting of soil and the resulting increase. Creation-and-leveling can be cultivation of conditions: completion includes a prepared substrate whose later growth requires productive rupture.

activation_trace.role: Measuring before cutting supplies deliberate preparation of material conditions.
A broad smooth tract supplies the prepared ground on which cultivation can operate.
Splitting and cutting supply the productive rupture of a previously leveled surface.
The cultivator who breaks the soil makes the agricultural mechanism explicit.
Increase and growth supply the living yield of prepared and opened ground.

structural_cues: The success-and-purification clause in 87:14 follows the earlier pasture cycle and uses two roots with agricultural branch images.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies cutting, the soil-breaking cultivator, and growth; I infer that focus-level preparation is substrate formation and that later rupture can fulfill rather than spoil it. The alternative is that agricultural images are lexical residues with no bearing on خلق فسوى.

changed_reading.before: A finished created form should remain smooth and intact.
changed_reading.after: He prepared a fitting substrate whose ordered purpose can be fulfilled through cultivation, opening, and growth.

context_deltas.mechanism: Preference selects the near, while delayed otherness, benefit, and endurance expose a longer horizon. Measurement and evenness in the focus become temporal allocation: a design is not rightly assessed only by immediate symmetry but by what its proportions preserve.

activation_trace.role: Apportioning before action supplies allocation across competing horizons.
Fairness and an even position supply the criterion by which allocations are compared.
Putting one thing first by choice supplies the selection pressure favoring immediacy.
Nearness supplies the short horizon that can distort evaluation.
Deferral to a later time supplies the competing long horizon.
Inclination toward useful good supplies a value criterion beyond proximity.
Duration and persistence supply the decisive long-term property.

structural_cues: 87:16-17 explicitly contrast preferred nearness with a later condition described as better and more enduring.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies choice, nearness, delay, benefit, and endurance; I infer that fair proportion must be evaluated across time and not only at the near surface. The alternative is a purely ethical comparison of two lives with no revision of the focus's formative mechanics.

changed_reading.before: Proportion is an immediately visible spatial balance.
changed_reading.after: Proportion is also a just allocation across temporal horizons, disclosed by what remains beneficial and enduring.

context_deltas.mechanism: Written sheets, their collection, beginning, and the split-root image of one thing following another activate creation-and-leveling as composition: measured units are arranged into a transmissible sequence rather than perfected in isolation.

activation_trace.role: Measuring before cutting supplies the planned dimensions of compositional units.
Matching and equivalence supply alignment among units in the composition.
A written sheet supplies the bounded surface on which ordered units become transmissible.
Gathering sheets into a codex supplies composition above the level of one unit.
Beginning and precedence supply an initial position in the ordered series.
The non-dominant image of one thing following another supplies serial succession.

structural_cues: 87:18 locates the teaching in earlier sheets, and 87:19 continues by naming two prior bearers of those sheets.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies pages, collection, precedence, and succession; I supply the composition analogy by which created units become an ordered whole. The alternative is that the closing verses only certify continuity of teaching and do not recast created order as inscription.

changed_reading.before: He creates and perfects each entity as an isolated whole.
changed_reading.after: He measures created units and aligns them into ordered, successive wholes capable of carrying a pattern across time.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it transfers a rise-and-settle branch associated with related forms of س و ي into the focus form. It remains anchored in سَوَّىٰ and in the immediately preceding upper-direction cue. Render it only as a spatial activation or analogy, not as a replacement gloss.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus sequence joins created aptitude to a س و ي branch of rising and settling on something.

activation_trace.role: Aptitude supplies entities fitted for differentiated stations.
Rising and settling on something supplies emplacement at a stable level.
The upper direction activates a vertical axis for the focus-side settlement image.

changed_reading.before: He equalized the form after creating it.
changed_reading.after: He created entities with fitting capacities and stationed them at stable levels within a vertical order.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it combines specialized terrain, water-storage, and flood-drift branches. It remains anchored in both focus roots and in 87:5's drift and containment inventory. Render it only as a landscape-engineering analogy, not as a lexical replacement for خَلَقَ or سَوَّىٰ.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: A خ ل ق branch names a water-holding hollow, while a س و ي branch names broad smooth ground.

activation_trace.role: A hollow in rock that retains rainwater supplies the catchment geometry.
Broad smooth ground supplies the graded receiving surface around the catchment.
Floating matter carried by a flood makes surface grading materially consequential.
Excavations and flats that hold water supply a context-side analogue to the focus hollow.

changed_reading.before: Creation and leveling describe the shape of an organism or object.
changed_reading.after: Creation and leveling can be glimpsed materially as forming catchments and grading surfaces so water and drift are directed and held.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the breaking image comes from the non-dominant ه د د mapping under the context root ه د ي. It remains anchored in the focus branch of becoming straight after crookedness and gives a genuine process change. Render it as a deliberately remote possibility, never as a claim that هَدَىٰ lexically means demolition here.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus's س و ي inventory includes straightening after crookedness, which can describe repair after disruption.

activation_trace.role: Origination supplies the form that may subsequently undergo disruptive reshaping.
Straightening after crookedness supplies rectification following disturbance.
The split-root image of severe breaking or demolition supplies the disruptive intermediate operation.

changed_reading.before: Created form proceeds smoothly and without interruption into completion.
changed_reading.after: Formation may pass through breaking or dismantling before rectification establishes a sounder course.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it reads later fire as a material-processing analogue to focus-side straightening. It remains tightly anchored in the focus completion branch and in a context branch explicitly joining fire to leveling. Render it as a tempering analogy while preserving the context's destructive fire as a materially live alternative.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: سَوَّىٰ supplies straightening and completion after origination.

activation_trace.role: Origination supplies the initially made form.
Straightness and completion supply the result of material tempering.
Kindling heat and leveling a thing by fire supplies the explicit thermal-processing mechanism.
Blazing fire supplies the material agent, while retaining the destructive reading.

changed_reading.before: He made the form and adjusted it geometrically.
changed_reading.after: He made the form and, by analogy with heat-working, tempered or straightened it into a completed condition.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates a form-distant س و ي branch of dropping a letter or passage and joins it to reading, forgetting, and scribal error. It remains anchored in the focus root and produces a changed compositional reading. Render it only as a shadow of selection within ordering, not as a textual-history claim or an assertion of loss in the named scrolls.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus's س و ي inventory includes omission, while خ ل ق includes prior planning and apportionment.

activation_trace.role: Planning and apportioning supply deliberate selection before composition.
Dropping or leaving out a letter or passage supplies omission as an edge case of ordering.
Reading and recitation supply the domain in which ordered inclusion and omission become perceptible.
Leaving or neglecting something supplies an alternative, non-deliberate route to absence.
Misreading or scribal corruption supplies the caution that absence can reflect error rather than design.

changed_reading.before: Creating and ordering work only by adding and completing material.
changed_reading.after: Ordered composition may also involve selection and bounded omission, while remaining vulnerable to accidental loss or misreading.

strongest_changes: The parallel قدر فهدى sequence turns proportion into measured capacity tuned for a guided path.
رب reopens the apparent finishing act as ongoing nurture, repair, and maturation.
The pasture-to-debris sequence rescales sound order from static perfection to ecological turnover.
The near-versus-enduring contrast changes visible balance into allocation judged across time.
summary.what_was_special: The focus roots supported simultaneous craft, character, affordance, ecology, cultivation, temporal allocation, and composition readings. Non-dominant mappings activated visible marking, disruptive reformation, and serial succession; specialized branches also preserved water-catchment, vertical-stationing, fire-tempering, and selective-omission outliers without promoting them to replacement glosses.
remaining_uncertainties: Several spatial and directional activations draw on related س و ي forms and may not transfer cleanly to the focus's Form II verb.
The ecological and temporal models move from an individual formed thing to system-level order; that rescaling is explanatory but reader-supplied.
The و س م, ه د د, and و ل ي activations are packet-authorized split-root cues but remain especially vulnerable to mapping distance.
